title: My Lady Parts by Doon Mackichan - #short review
transcript: If You're Expecting my lady parts to be the typical Showbiz autobiography with amusing anecdotes about working with Maggie Smith John Goodman or John malovich you will be disappointed and while I'm telling you what this book is not perhaps I should say that for someone who started her career as a stand-up comedian and who has written and appeared in so much great comedy there aren't that many laughs what it is is an almost continuous indictment of the misogyny and discrimination that she and other women have experienced in Show Business in this book Miss mcken makes an impassioned plea not only for more female comedy writers and performers to be given a chance on TV film and in theater but for more stories by and about women and for women to choose to be themselves not a male fantasy
